name: Changing Tastes

angles.text: Borstan hopes to raise rustic meals to a grander height for the Horde capital, as tastes and tavern menus evolve beyond village staples.
Supplying Borstan's Firepit means crossing the sea into contested Wetlands to bring exotic meat back to Orgrimmar.

faq.answer: Changing Tastes is a culinary task in Orgrimmar. Borstan, owner of Borstan's Firepit, seeks thicket raptor meat from the distant Wetlands to raise his menu above basic village cooking.
faq.q: What is the quest Changing Tastes?

faq.answer: Zamja is an associate and fellow culinary worker who suggests homestyle raptor dishes for Borstan's Firepit, hoping to attract customers who do not usually visit.
Borstan's Firepit is an eatery in Orgrimmar, the Horde capital. It serves hearty cooked meats to locals and travelers alike.
Borstan wants a grander take on familiar flavors than Zamja's homestyle raptor cooking. A hunter's tale of giant talons inspires him to seek thicket raptor meat from the Wetlands.
faq.q: Why does Borstan want thicket raptor meat?

aliases: where do i find thicket raptors
faq.answer: Thicket raptors live at excavation sites in the Wetlands, an Alliance-leaning region across the Great Sea in the Eastern Kingdoms.
faq.q: Where are the thicket raptors located?

faq.answer: Borstan, proprietor of Borstan's Firepit in Orgrimmar, offers Changing Tastes after Zamja's advice and a trophy brought back by an adventurous hunter inspire him.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Changing Tastes?

sections.body: Borstan's Firepit in Orgrimmar hopes to widen its menu. Zamja suggests homestyle raptor cooking for travelers who miss the familiar meals of their birth villages. Borstan likes the thought of drawing new patrons with raptor, but simple village fare seems too modest for the Horde's great capital. He wants a bolder version of the old staple.
sections.title: Elevating Capital Cuisine

sections.body: A hunter returns to Orgrimmar with a massive talon from a thicket raptor of the Wetlands excavation sites. The beast's size and quality catch Borstan's interest. He arranges for adventurers to cross the sea to the Eastern Kingdoms, brave the excavation grounds, and bring back prime thicket raptor meat for his fires.
sections.title: The Hunt in the Wetlands

summary: At Borstan's Firepit, a new dish may bring travelers to Orgrimmar. Zamja's advice and tales of giant raptor talons lead Borstan to seek thicket raptor meat from the Wetlands across the sea.
